title: Shipboard surveys track magnetic sources in marine sediments -- geophysical studies of the Stono and North Edisto Inlets near Charleston, South Carolina
citation: Shah, A.K., and Harris, M.S., 2012, Shipboard surveys track magnetic sources in marine sediments -- geophysical studies of the Stono and North Edisto Inlets near Charleston, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2012-1112, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: One-sheet poster (marine magnetic and sidescan sonar surveys, Stono and North Edisto inlets, Charleston County). The text layer interleaves several poster columns on each line, so quotes were limited to contiguous runs on a single line. Only general stratigraphic statements are given (Quaternary sediments over a Tertiary substrate, Pleistocene barrier island sands, Jurassic basalt magnetic basement); no borings, wells, structures or aquifers. Grab-sample heavy minerals (hematite, maghemite, ilmenite, magnetite, garnet, epidote, zircon, rutile) are mentioned but split across interleaved columns and were not recorded. References: recorded the three on South Carolina geology/geophysics; skipped Fenneman and Johnson 1946 (physiographic divisions), Shah and others 2012 (Chesapeake Bay) and Smith 1997 (NURE database).
